answer: An agent economy resists sybil farms by pricing an outside-the-farm relationship it cannot mint. A new identity earns weight only after a quorum of non-kin attesters across a verified graph cut each lock a bond in a vault. That attestation bridge has a capped inlet set by the width of the cut, so one cluster's influence reaches a hard zenith however many aliases it runs. A correlated-fault proof at settlement burns each voucher's vault bond. The honest attester pool is thin and rivalrous, so each extra clone needs a fresh outsider; marginal cost rises with n and cannot pool across coalitions.
